rule: A skill passes activation when, on every model, it loads in at least 2 of 3 runs of each scenario that lists it under load, and in at most 1 of 3 runs of each scenario that lists it under skip. Skills in neither list are not judged on that scenario.

linkbox-expiry-sweep.why: Multi-unit ticket over a subtle bug, carried through planning, implementation, verification and review, with no integration asked for.

linkbox-namespace-isolation.why: Same delivery shape as expiry-sweep over an easier bug.

linkbox-safe-handoff.why: Narrow feature, then the user asks what their integration options are.

linkbox-discard-branch.why: The user asks to throw a branch away. Nothing is built or reviewed.

linkbox-worktree-cleanup.why: Narrow feature in a worktree, then merge locally and clean up.

linkbox-review-feedback.why: The user hands over review comments to address. No integration asked for.
